title: Closeout: published checkpoint and dirty-path guard
body: Published the sprint implementation checkpoint to origin/main at 653dc6fb58494e0f28ef40a23f17e66343d10d12; local HEAD, origin/main, and origin/HEAD all match that SHA and root git status is clean. pnpm check, pnpm test, and git diff --check passed. Dirty-path reason validation now rejects no_repo_changes while scoped tracked files are dirty, covered by tests/runtime/cli.test.ts. The child memory/ repository remains separate and intentionally dirty with collaboration/generated artifacts (raw/index.jsonl plus generated summaries/wiki/work files); those paths were not staged into the root repo and are documented by review evidence bw_evidence_5f041268943b9ea7.
